title: 2400-baud modem
blurb: Twice as fast as anything in the shop. The circuit diagram is half-burnt, but the half you have is the important half.

title: Bulletin board software
blurb: Message boards, file areas, overnight mail. A town square that fits on a hard disk.

title: Multi-line hunt group
blurb: Busy signal? Roll to the next line. Customers stop hearing 'engaged'.

title: Automated billing
blurb: Invoices that write themselves. Mistakes that copy themselves.

title: Network monitoring
blurb: Equipment that tells you it is ill before customers do. Most of the time.

title: 14.4k modem bank
blurb: A shelf of modems answering in turn. Heat, noise, and a bigger upstream bill.

title: The web
blurb: Pages that link to pages. PIP's notes underline this three times.

title: Dial-in authentication
blurb: One server checks every login. Put a second one somewhere else.

title: ADSL
blurb: Always-on over copper. Distance from the exchange becomes destiny.

title: Exchange 0
blurb: The last page. Your name is on the work order. The date will not stay still.
